title: Ungulate vocalizations and production context
question: How do acoustic relationships transfer across animals and recording contexts?
publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: Lefèvre, Romain Adrien (University of Copenhagen); Sypherd, Ciara Cleo-Rose (Harvard University); Mandel-Briefer, Élodie Floriane (University of Copenhagen)
measurement_dates: Multiple original studies and acquisition periods, not one 2025 recording campaign. Deposit 2025.
variables_and_units: Variables and units are preserved in native column headers, instrument metadata and source dictionaries; see evidence anchors below.
independent_units: Animal, species and complete call/recording group.
validation_design: Animal, species and complete call/recording group. Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Extracted/segmented animal contact calls rather than continuous microphone streams; source contextual labels and original filenames are retained. The source spelling WidlBoar is not corrected.
prior_analysis_and_limits: The source study is DOI 10.1016/j.isci.2025.111834 (PMC11847267). Valence is a context-derived label, not direct access to animal internal state. Animal, study and recording conditions may confound acoustic associations. 3,181 extracted ungulate WAV calls and metadata; call extraction is author preprocessing. Calls from one animal are dependent.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.
